title: Riso Lane COORD — answers, hooks, macros, catalog, context parity

questions.prompt: What should this COORD goal package primarily enable?
questions.description: Sibling lane goals are empty; this package will drive /goal runs. Infer from your multi-agent wave model: COORD is Wave 0 serial owner. Pick how much “standing process” vs “apply concrete backlog” this goal should own.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Standing COORD operating protocol: accept structured handoffs, apply smallest coherent contract, document payload handoffs — no fixed feature backlog in this package.

options.label: Standing protocol only
options.description: Define how COORD applies handoffs and verifies; no specific prompt/catalog batch baked into the goal.

options.label: Protocol + known backlog
options.description: Same protocol, plus list first concrete contract items to apply when /goal runs.

options.label: Concrete backlog only
options.description: Skip process docs; goal is only a specific set of contract changes.

questions.prompt: How should other lanes request COORD contract changes?
questions.description: Codebase has no formal handoff schema yet. COORD must stay serial and not invent payload work. Choose the inbound contract shape.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Structured markdown under goals/<requesting-lane>/handoffs/ or goals/riso-lane-coord/inbox/ with required sections: prompt keys, defaults, when-conditions, hook rules, catalog rows, context snippets, payload follow-ups.

options.label: Markdown handoff schema
options.description: Template sections in goals/; human or agent fills fields; COORD applies.

options.label: JSON handoff schema
options.description: Machine-checked JSON fields only; stricter, less narrative.

options.label: Ad-hoc chat/PR notes
options.description: No fixed schema; COORD interprets freeform proposals (higher error risk).

questions.prompt: Where should COORD publish the contract delta for payload lanes?
questions.description: After COORD edits copier/hooks/catalog/context, payload lanes need a clear “implement this, do not re-touch COORD” note.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Write goals/riso-lane-coord/outbox/<change-id>.md (or per-lane handoffs/) listing: answer keys changed, illegal combos now enforced, module_catalog rows, context files, and exact payload paths each lane owns.

options.label: Chat summary only
options.description: No durable file; summarize in session (weaker multi-agent continuity).

questions.prompt: How should COORD treat shared generation_gates under src/riso/core/?
questions.description: pre_gen_project.py and post_gen import riso.core.generation_gates (CLI lane write root). Hook wrappers live under template/hooks/ (COORD). This is the main cross-lane boundary risk.
questions.recommendedAnswer: COORD owns template/hooks validation UX and may add local hook checks; any change to src/riso/core/generation_gates.py is a structured handoff to the CLI lane — COORD never edits src/riso/**.

options.label: Handoff gates to CLI lane
options.description: COORD does not touch src/riso; proposes gate changes via outbox for CLI.

options.label: COORD may edit generation_gates
options.description: Treat generation_gates as COORD-adjacent exception (breaks strict CLI ownership).

options.label: Duplicate rules in hooks only
options.description: Keep all new rules in pre_gen only; avoid shared gates (drift risk).

questions.prompt: What is the default verification bar after applying a handoff?
questions.description: Commands exist: verify_context_sync, riso validate, riso prompts, riso catalog, tests/unit/hooks/. Full matrix regen is out of scope unless proving a contract.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Always: context sync if context touched; riso validate on affected sample answers; narrow hook/unit tests when hooks/validators change; optional prompts/catalog smoke. Never full sample matrix unless human asks or contract unprovable otherwise.

options.label: riso validate on affected sample answers
Narrow tests under tests/unit/hooks when hooks change

questions.prompt: On the first /goal run for this package, what should the agent actually do?
questions.description: Goal packages for empty lanes often need a bootstrap deliverable. Prefer something durable without inventing product features.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Bootstrap COORD artifacts only: handoff template, outbox template, lane checklist, and a dry-run verification of current context parity + one sample validate — no unsolicited copier.yml churn.

options.label: Bootstrap handoff/outbox templates + dry-run verify
options.description: No contract churn unless an inbox handoff already exists.

options.label: Audit current contracts for drift
options.description: Scan copier/hooks/catalog/context for known inconsistencies and fix only proven COORD bugs.

options.label: No files until a real handoff arrives
options.description: Goal package is documentation only; first apply waits for another lane.
